notes.title: Patch for Mac version, v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we've been aware of some issues with the Mac version and I so so appreciate your patience while we solve them. I've just updated the game with a new Mac build that should solve a fair number of startup errors that people have been experiencing.

It may not fix every bug though, so if you are still experiencing problems with this version please don't hesitate to reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/t85AhwqWrd]Discord[/url]. 

Special thank you to ABunchOfBirds for helping me troubleshoot some bugs. I have a lead on the cause of a specific issue and will update you folks here when I make progress!

Wham wham,

Mark B

notes.title: Wham Wham's Redemption out NOW! v1.1.0
notes.content:
Wauw, it's almost been an entire year since we released Everybody Wham Wham! Can you believe it? Originally we planned to finish this game and then move straight on to the next one, but sometimes a game studio simply doesn't have a choice...

We knew Wham Wham's story wasn't over. We had to tell the good people out there what happens to the snowiest snow king in all the land. So ever since release we've been brainstorming how exactly to do that and, well, this update is the result of that. Appropriately (in my opinion) called:

[b]Wham Wham's Redemption[/b]

[i]One year later, Evil Bentworth has taken over the snowman building festival to create his very own snowy-woodman-man army. Will Koenraad be able to convince Wham Wham and Bling Bling to put their differences aside for the sake of the Snowking Kingdom? Find out if our favorite snowman-man can make up for his troubled past in Wham Wham's Redemption, a new post-credits story![/i]

[previewyoutube=cG4fzog9VcU;full][/previewyoutube]
While the main game is crazy in all sorts of ways, this update just takes things even further. To speak personally, something that's meant a lot to me is how you folks embrace all the weird stuff we make and are so supportive. It gives us so much confidence to make the game [i]we[/i] would want to play, with no compromises or filtering our ideas. We put our hearts into this lil update and I hope it shows <3

[h1]v1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] New post-credits story Wham Wham's Redemption!
[*] Fixed Pumpkin-Hat Person facing the wrong direction during certain conversations
[*] Footsteps SFX accidentally removed and now restored
[*] Pressing Escape in options menu returns you to the main menu
[*] Radio is louder when talking to Koenraad & Bentworth in the hub
[*] Throwing a snowball at Piggy/Snailmn while they are shocked because you sabotaged them no longer puts them in a forever-shocked loop (it was pretty funny though)
[*] Easier to convert a competitor's snowball to your snowball when you roll it to your build spot
[*] Background conversations are now a bit louder
[*] Improved memory usage
[/list]

Have fun with the new story, would love to hear what you all think!

Mark B

notes.title: 🎃 Halloween Update 🎃
notes.content:
Boo! Sorry, didn't mean to scare ya. I'm just SO excited to tell you about all the new stuff we added to Everybody Wham Wham for Halloween!! 

This time of year is special for the 4 of us at Bonte Avond because 1) we made our very first game jam game back around Halloween 2019 and 2) Halloween is basically the best day ever. I mean carving pumpkins, ghost stories by the campfire, cackling like a crazy witch -- what's not to love?

So we knew we wanted to do a fun update, but this one is [i]extra[/i] special because this is the first time we've involved our community in designing new items! We gave them a lil template and told them to let their spooky imaginations run wild. Here's a couple examples made by Fawkes and Michelle:

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39507487/eebb6df71de4b145bb36103fee699a9214efc2cc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39507487/5ff2ade9cba3cc7fbc97e1a90ac800216724b9f8.png[/img]

We then took their designs and made them into vector art! Check out their cauldron hat and skeleton arm:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39507487/4f361f380d76e85715455e072a45f18d4b0f4d52.png[/img] 

There's a whole bunch more items to find from lots more creative people (check the credits below). We'll definitely be doing more community-driven updates in the future, so if you want to take part join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/t85AhwqWrd]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Halloween-Themed Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Two new spooky characters (appearing in the Hub on day 4 and day 8)
[*] Day 8 is now Halloween-themed and you can make a very special snowman
[*] Over a dozen new spooky items designed by our Discord community! Special thank you to to our artist extraordinaires: Fawkes, HeckinRobin, Sky Colon, Jas Wong, Martine, Michelle (Azura) and Sho Goldman
[/list]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Filesize & Memory improvements
[*] Character now stand behind snowman when placing items so you can see what you do
[*] Throwables now flip horizontally
[*] Adjusted some of the match time lengths and expanded our timer algorithm for a more chill experience when you're good at making snowman
[*] Suspicion meter more visible
[*] Can't stack someone else’s snowball on top of their other snowball anymore
[*] Improved menu screen navigation (Play section + Discord link)
[*] Some color adjustments in the main menu (start screen Bonte Avond logo)
[*] Snowballs can be made bigger
[*] Snowballs are now different in 2D-depth and the highest snowball always appears on top of the others
[*] Items are now randomized in the Hub carriage and fewer items appear (so it is less crowded)
[*] You now walk next to a character to face them in a conversation after interacting instead of accidentally standing on top of them
[*] Some items will appear randomly and can be rare
[*] Redid some of the Tutorial to make text/explanations more clear
[*] Day 9 SPOILER: [spoiler] Sugarspider cafe all-you-can-eat cotton is now truly all-you-can-eat! [/spoiler]
[*] Updated credits roll visuals
[*] Game recognizes controller input, even while playing the game
[*] Game layout changes depending on what type of controller you use
[/list]
Enjoy all the new features, Happy Halloween everyone! 

Mark B

notes.title: Mac version out now, 40% special discount! Patch v1.0.23
notes.content:
We have some great news for all you Mac users out there: you can now play Everybody Wham Wham!! We spent the last month troubleshooting some compatibility issues with shaders and it was so exciting to see that everything is running smoothly. 

To celebrate the Mac release we’re offering a very special, end-of-winter 40% discount! This patch also comes with a few bug fixes and additions (including new music!). Stay tuned though, the official soundtrack is in the works and will be releasing soon as well!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Added some guitar strums to the tutorial!
[*] Slightly lowered menu music in volume
[*] Redid parts of the Bloom/Blur shader for MacOS compatibility
[*] [b]Balance:[/b] Suspicion-meter is a bit slower when you’re close to Piggy or Snailmn while sabotaging their snowman
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Bentworth Tutorial Signs were visible on the left/right of your screen when you have a super wide screen during tutorial
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Items became semi-transparent after getting caught sabotaging
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Sometimes items would become invisible while trying to place them (rare)
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Bentworth would end his dancing animation on a weird frame during the tutorial song
[/list]

notes.content:
Hi everyone, we've had an amazing day seeing you all play Everybody Wham Wham! Some of you wonderful folks have gotten in touch about bugs so we're doing a quick patch today to fix a few things. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed code bug with the Igloo for Winners 70 point requirement
[*]Added slightly more time to contest levels
[*]Koenraad voice line bug fixed!
[*]Fixed some dialogue spelling errors (thanks zedsquadron!)
[*]Audio bug with northern lights music fixed!
[/list]

That's it! Hope you're all enjoying the game and remember: wham wham.
